Name: Orangeblossom's Furniture Catalogue
Author: orangeblossom7
Description:
[center][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3][b]Orangeblossom's Furniture Catalogue[url=https://emojipedia.org/tangerine]
[/url][/b][i]by orangeblossom
[/i]
﻿❀﻿[b][url=https://emojipedia.org/tangerine]🍊[/url][/b]❀﻿[b][url=https://emojipedia.org/tangerine]🍊[/url][/b]❀[/size][/font][/center]
[size=3]I want to make more furniture but I don't want to put out multiple catalogues because it can be annoying, and that's why I decided to just make a general catalogue for my future furniture mods. (plus you can pick and choose which furniture mods from me you want to put in your game)[/size]

[b][font=Arial][color=#fff2cc][size=4][i]Please download and install the [u]CP version[/u] of the furniture sets listed in the requirements section ([u]see mods requiring this file[/u]) from their respective mod pages. If you don't do that, no furniture will show up in this catalogue and it MIGHT crash your game (but only if you have happy home designer installed).[/i][/size][/color][/font][/b][font=Lucida Sans Unicode]
[/font][center][/center][center][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3]
❀﻿[b][url=https://emojipedia.org/tangerine]🍊[/url][/b]❀﻿[b]🍊[/b]❀
[/size][/font][/center][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=3]
[u]How to use:[/u]
1. Download and install this mod (+ it's requirements);
2. Download and install my furniture mods that require this mod (check the requirements tab);
3. Open your game;
4. Go to Robin's Shop (make sure you have 20,000g);
5. Buy Orangeblossom's Furniture Catalogue;
6. Interact with the catalogue to access my furniture. If it crashes or says out of stock, you did not correctly install the furniture mod.

[u]Notes:[/u]
- [u]This mod does not contain furniture by itself[/u]; you'll have to download the furniture sets [i]separately[/i].
- To know which furniture sets are compatible with this mod, check the requirements tab.
[color=#f9cb9c][b]-[/b] [/color][b][color=#f9cb9c]Please download the [/color][u]CP version[/u][color=#f9cb9c] of the furniture set from their respective mod pages (if you don't do that, no furniture will show up in this catalogue).[/color]
[color=#f4cccc]- Only Basic Bedroom Furniture has an AT version (that is not a recolor). That means you can use it without installing this catalogue. [/color]
[/b]- 1.6 only
- I recommend installing [b]Happy Home Designer[/b][b] [/b]because it makes decorating and accessing different swatches easier.
